# One command

> **One command, always the same, that leaves you oriented.**

That is the whole reason for reaching for fathom at all, and it answers three
things at once:

| | |
|---|---|
| **is this sound?** | valid, whole, and free of silent damage |
| **what is in here?** | the structure folded to its shape, with the fold reported |
| **what could one row be?** | every defensible answer, and what each would cost |

It is one verb rather than three because **a diagnostic people *can* skip is a
diagnostic people *do* skip.**

The three chapters of this part are those three questions, in that order. The
first two describe something that runs, and show it running. The third
describes the half that is designed, prototyped and not yet in the core, and
says so.
